findings.title: PHI conflict inside manufacturer sources
findings.details: S31 ghi PHI 7 ngày cho 'sương mai/cà chua', trong khi S33 ghi PHI 5 ngày. Đốm vòng/cà chua nhất quán ở 5 ngày.
findings.required_action: Verify current product label/registration document before seed.

findings.title: Dose range requires schema support
findings.details: Real labels use dose ranges (e.g. 0.25-0.5 L/ha). A single Float dose loses source meaning.

findings.title: Disease-name semantic mapping requires agronomist review
findings.details: PlantVillage English class labels cannot be automatically equated to broad Vietnamese registration terms such as 'đốm lá'.
findings.required_action: Add reviewed mapping table disease_code ↔ registered_target_text.

findings.title: Manufacturer page has no PHI for Anti-Xo 200WP
findings.required_action: Locate current product label/registration instructions containing PHI before final seed.

findings.title: PlantVillage contains a pest class inside Disease catalog
findings.required_action: Treat as pest/arachnid management in structured data; do not force fungal/bacterial disease semantics.

findings.title: Vietnamese registration target can be broader than CV class
findings.details: Two-spotted spider mite is more specific than the registration term 'nhện đỏ'.
findings.required_action: Require agronomist mapping approval before deterministic treatment lookup.

findings.title: Broad Vietnamese target terms cannot be treated as exact CV class mappings
findings.details: Ortiva 600SC is registered/labeled for 'đốm lá/cà chua', but that term is broader than both Tomato Leaf Mold and Septoria Leaf Spot.

findings.title: Crop mismatch in powdery mildew candidate
findings.details: Current registration found for Thumb 0.5SL is 'phấn trắng/bí xanh', while the CV class is Squash.
findings.required_action: Do not seed until crop equivalence/registration is confirmed.

findings.title: Secondary source cannot establish final PHI
findings.details: Thumb 0.5SL dose/PHI values currently come from a retailer copy, not a primary manufacturer/label source.
findings.required_action: Find current product label or primary manufacturer instructions.
